query: SELECT trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, span_name, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, duration, is_exception, attributes->>'gen_ai.agent.call.id' AS agent_run_id, attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens' AS input_tokens, attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.output_tokens' AS output_tokens FROM records WHERE service_name = 'vis-eval-maturity50-glm-gemma-v1' AND kind = 'span' ORDER BY start_timestamp, span_id LIMIT 3000
